notes:
E-Sys MAX 4.9.4

Fixed
- Setting names in the FDL editor show again on E-Sys 25.10.
- Full backup reads the whole car on one press again, and twin modules keep their own coding.
- Light look: car tiles keep the car's real paint colour.

New
- Dark (new): a sharper dark look for E-Sys, picked in the launcher.
- Home: even garage tiles, a best-match hint and older versions folded away.

Changes
- The free trial is its own app now: E-Sys MAX Trial. A trial licence works there; the full E-Sys MAX is for bought licences.
- Start free trial opens esysmax.com/trial, where you get E-Sys MAX Trial.
- Car recovery explains twin modules more clearly.
- Full backup says how to connect when no car is connected.
- Stronger protection under the hood.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
